name: Filthy Paws
summary: In Silver Stream Mine, Filthy Paws supplies wait in danger. The Miners' League stored its equipment there after the ore ran dry, but kobolds now fill the tunnels. Mountaineer Stormpike wants the tools recovered before his warriors attack.

sections.title: A Depleted Depot
sections.body: Silver Stream Mine lies in northern Loch Modan, east of Algaz Station. Its silver ran out long ago, so the dwarven Miners' League turned the empty shafts into a depot for spare excavation gear, picks, and staging materials. Across Khaz Modan, sturdy tunnels make good storehouses, provided they stay guarded and locked against the wilderness.

sections.title: Paws in the Depot
sections.body: As dwarven watchfulness across Loch Modan has thinned, kobolds have slipped into the mine. Dark shafts and gleaming iron tools drew the scavengers, and soon the depot became their warren. Mountaineer Stormpike is ready to lead warriors inside and drive them out, but their heavy boots and sweeping blows could smash the crates. You can slip or fight your way in to recover the League's supplies before the assault begins.

faq.q: Why was gear left in the mine if it had already run dry?
aliases: why is gear in silver stream mine
faq.answer: After the ore ran dry, the Miners' League made Silver Stream Mine a central depot. Its dry, solid tunnels sheltered bulky tools and supplies until they were needed elsewhere.

faq.q: Why doesn't Mountaineer Stormpike clear the mine himself?
faq.answer: Stormpike is under orders to wait. The Miners' League also wants its gear recovered first, since warriors rushing through narrow, dark shafts could smash the crated tools in the fight.

faq.q: Where is the Silver Stream Mine located?
faq.answer: Silver Stream Mine lies in northern Loch Modan, east of Algaz Station and southwest of the Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: What makes kobolds so interested in dwarven tools?
faq.answer: Kobolds scavenge beneath the earth and covet metal picks, shovels, candles, and finished ironwork. A storehouse of dwarven tools makes burrowing easier and is hard for them to resist.

faq.q: Is the Silver Stream Mine dangerous to explore alone?
faq.answer: Narrow passages and dense clusters of kobolds make the mine dangerous. Mountaineer Stormpike warns that you may want companions with you.

faq.q: Who owns the supplies stored in the mine?
faq.answer: The supplies belong to the Ironforge Miners' League, the trade guild overseeing quarrying, mining, and subterranean resources across the dwarven kingdom.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may see kobolds defiling the Miners' League's craft as an insult calling for swift reclamation and sharp steel.
As a miner, you know the worth of high-grade dwarven gear and what is lost when useful tools rust in the paws of cave vermin.
As an Alliance member, you know clearing supply depots helps keep vital infrastructure open while dwarven defenses are stretched thin across Khaz Modan.
